functions.description: Extract base fields (timestamp, host, pid, severity, message) from esxtokend syslog line
Convert extracted timestamp string to epoch _time
Extract user field from quoted or key=value user patterns in message
Extract IPv4 source address from common keyword prefixes (from, source=, client=, src=, host=, IP)
Extract IPv6 source address enclosed in brackets when IPv4 not present
Classify action as success or failure based on message keywords

add.name: _time
add.value: (typeof log_time != 'undefined' && log_time) ? (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : new Date(String(log_time)).getTime()) / 1000 : _time
